categories.title: Spiritspring Jump
categories.info: While riding Torrent, Spiritspring Jumps are used to soar to a high-up area, or safely land in a lower one.

categories.title: Stake of Marika
categories.info: Upon dying within the vicinity of a Stake of Marika, you may choose to respawn there instead of a Site of Grace.

categories.title: Scadutree Fragment
categories.info: Scadutree Fragments can be consumed to bolster your Scadutree Blessing, which increases your Attack Power and Damage Negation in the Shadow Realm.

categories.title: Crystal Tear
categories.info: At any Site of Grace, combine with another Crystal Tear in the [Flask of Wondrous Physick](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164723). Lasts for 3 minutes unless otherwise noted.

categories.title: Larval Tear
categories.info: **Utility:** Trade to [Rennala](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165895) to gain rebirth and reallocate attribute points.

categories.title: Rune Arc
categories.template:
**Location:** ??  
**Utility:** Consume to activate a Great Rune's power. Lasts until you die.

categories.title: Spirit Ashes
categories.info:
**Spirit Ashes** are summonable companions that can aid the player in combat. After receiving the [Spirit Calling Bell](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167800), the player may summon any acquired Spirit Ash by paying its cost when in range of a Rebirth Monument.

After completing Roderika's Task, [Roderika](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=170232) can upgrade any Spirit Ash with the corresponding upgrade material, up to +10.

categories.title: Elite Enemy
categories.info: Tough enemies that typically have unique loot, and may not respawn once killed.

categories.title: Glovewort
categories.info:
**Utility:** Give to [Roderika](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=170232) to upgrade Spirit Ashes.  
- A Grave Glovewort [X] upgrades a standard Spirit Ash to +X.
- A Ghost Glovewort [X] upgrades an elite Spirit Ash to +X.
